values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (803-428-5307). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lee/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/lee/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site'), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC agency row

note: Family campground; the equestrian sites are a separate area. --Claude
